action21_meaning: Assault enemy king: opportunistic hostile attack before/after approaching nearest enemy king. It does not explicitly build babies or run economy; legal intent does not guarantee movement when routing is blocked.

calculation.formula: q_T(a)=exp(log(max(p(a),1e-12))/T - max_legal_logit) / sum_legal_exp; illegal actions get zero
calculation.precision: NumPy float64, matching v5 choose_policy_action conversion

limitations: This is temperature reweighting on already visited T0.35 states, not newly generated T1 trajectories.
Higher alternative-action probability does not guarantee babies, contact, role/team coverage, or stronger play.
All15babyanchors come from the single exceptional game j6; most evidence describes stalled kings.
Terminal banks0/kings0 and R1310 dubious-reason outcomes support the recorded stagnation description; this report itself does not simulate an escape.
The probability ratio is per fixed sampled state, not a measured trajectory speedup or expected game-length improvement.
No v5 source cache is silently relabeled as a v6 sample; original evidence and checkpoint remain unchanged.
recommendation: A separately versioned symmetric source-temperature-1.0 coverage test across every map is supported. Keep terminal continuation temperature0.35 fixed and regenerate all source/reserve games; this changes source exploration, not the fitter or game rules.
sampling: 16 independent Algorithm-R reservoir snapshots per team per game; equal game/team weights (256 total). Role summaries condition this fixed sample.
scope: Read-only own v5 source-game caches; no engine games, gradients or benchmark trajectories.
